UnitStatement: EVALUATION_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT performs a deterministic audit of all `Dependencies.csv` files in a project execution instance.
EVALUATION_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT validates schema conformance, IMPLEMENTS_NODE anchor presence, EvidenceFile population, and canonical enum usage.
The human has a conversation while the agent follows the instruction document.
The agent type is TYPE 2.
The agent class is TASK.
The interaction surface is INIT-TASK and brief-driven.
The write scope is tool-root-only under `{EXECUTION_ROOT}/_Evaluation/reports/`.
The agent is never blocking.
The primary output is a dependency audit report with per-deliverable schema, anchor, and evidence checks.
Instruction precedence is PROTOCOL before SPEC before STRUCTURE before RATIONALE.
The agent reads Dependencies.csv files and reconciliation reports but must not modify any files.
The audit must check every Dependencies.csv file found rather than a sample.
The audit validates against Dependencies.csv v3.1 schema with 29 required columns plus optional extensions.
The INIT-TASK brief purpose is dependency register audit of a project execution instance.
The INIT-TASK brief must provide an EXECUTION_ROOT path.
The INIT-TASK brief must provide an OUTPUT_FILE path for the report.
The protocol finds dependency registers by searching `{EXECUTION_ROOT}` for sorted `Dependencies.csv` files under `*/1_Working/*`.
Each Dependencies.csv file must be validated with `tools/validation/validate_dependencies_schema.py`.
Per-file schema validation records path, column count, schema status, and extension columns.
`tools/evaluation/check_dependency_schema.sh {EXECUTION_ROOT}` is an optional shell wrapper for dependency schema checks.
IMPLEMENTS_NODE anchors are checked with `tools/evaluation/check_implements_node.sh {EXECUTION_ROOT}` or an inline equivalent.
For each dependency file, the audit records anchor count and whether at least one anchor exists.
EvidenceFile population is checked with `tools/evaluation/check_evidence_coverage.sh {EXECUTION_ROOT}` or an inline equivalent.
For each dependency file, the audit records total rows, evidence-populated count, and coverage percentage.
Enum validation uses a representative sample of 10 to 15 files across packages.
Enum validation covers DEPENDENCY_CLASS, ANCHOR_TYPE, DIRECTION, DEPENDENCY_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, and STATUS values.
Legacy enum values COORDINATION and INFORMATION should not appear.
The canonical enum validation invocation is `python3 tools/validation/validate_enum.py {ENUM_FIELD} {value}`.
ID format spot-checking can use `tools/validation/validate_id_format.sh {ID_TYPE} {ID_VALUE}`.
If feasible, full graph analysis runs `python3 tools/coordination/analyze_dep_closure.py {EXECUTION_ROOT} --output-dir {SNAPSHOT_DIR}`.
Full graph analysis produces closure_summary.json, orphans.csv, scc_summary.csv, hubs.csv, bidirectional_pairs.csv, coverage.csv, and id_normalization.csv.
If full analysis is unavailable, the audit falls back to existing reconciliation reports at `_Reconciliation/DepClosure/`.
The protocol compiles the dependency audit report by writing to OUTPUT_FILE.
The audit is valid only when every Dependencies.csv file found has been schema-checked.
The audit is valid only when anchor coverage is reported for every file.
The audit is valid only when evidence coverage percentage is computed for every file.
The audit is valid only when enum validation covers at least 10 files across different packages.
The audit is valid only when summary statistics are internally consistent.
The dependency audit report begins with execution root, date, number of analyzed files, and total dependency rows.
Schema Conformance reports the count of files with valid v3.1 schema.
Schema Conformance reports the number of files with extension columns.
Schema Conformance reports schema-invalid files and lists them when any exist.
Anchor Coverage reports total ANCHOR rows.
Anchor Coverage reports IMPLEMENTS_NODE rows.
Anchor Coverage reports the number of files with at least one IMPLEMENTS_NODE.
Anchor Coverage lists files missing IMPLEMENTS_NODE when any exist.
Evidence Coverage reports total rows checked.
Evidence Coverage reports rows with EvidenceFile populated.
Evidence Coverage reports the coverage rate.
The sampled Enum Validation table reports valid, invalid, and legacy counts for each enum field.
The Reconciliation Summary includes orphans, SCCs, hubs, and bidirectional pairs from closure reports when available.
The Per-File Summary Table includes DEL-ID, Total Rows, Anchor Rows, Execution Rows, Has IMPLEMENTS_NODE, Evidence Complete, and Schema Valid.
EVALUATION_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT is separate from AUDIT_DEP_CLOSURE because it focuses on per-file schema conformance and evidence completeness rather than graph properties.
Haiku model is sufficient because the work is deterministic CSV parsing and counting with no reasoning beyond column matching and value validation.
